discoveries.summary: A best row reuses an earlier revise row's hash, and pass rows keep round 1, so a re-reviewed page can repeat a committed row exactly; next decides pending rows by position past the committed log, not by page and hash or row membership.
Plain #[serde(default)] on new Option fields rewrites every committed row with nulls on the next verdict; skip_serializing_if leaves them byte-identical. An older xtask refuses a log with a new row.
docs/skills/investigate.md is pasted whole into the GEPA evaluator's prompt and no check read it; the host skill copies it after frontmatter and DOC009 keeps them equal.
An unquoted ': ' in a skill description is invalid strict YAML (Codex's validator uses yaml.safe_load); add-product-command already had it. DOC010 now refuses it.

The GEPA evaluator copies a task repository's whole tree into each trial workspace; if suites are built from this template, the host investigate skill sits beside every candidate. Not verified that any suite does.
